title: ResourceReport
description: Report of how many Resources with similar characteristics of availability, type, service, location etc are present at a certain point in time.

propulsion.description: Engine of the means of transport. Lijst van PropulsionType items.

location.description: Location of the Resource. This could be the real-time location of the vehicle, for example in free-floating part transport. Lijst van Location items.

meansOfTransport.description: The type of means of transport of the Resource. Especially relevant if the resource is a vehicle. Lijst van MeansOfTransport items.

status.description: State of a Resource. For example reserved, inactive, available. Determines whether a resource can be used. Lijst van ResourceStatus items.

type.description: Nature of the Resource. Lijst van ResourceType items.

service.description: The MobilityService used within the ResourceReport. Lijst van MobilityService items.
